blocks.x: Robots into workflows — AMRs, cobots and autonomous vehicles integrated with safety and orchestration.

Robotics projects stall between pilot and fleet: the demo works, the integration doesn't. We deliver the integration discipline that closes that gap — fleet orchestration (multi-vendor AMR/cobot coordination, traffic and charging policy), WMS/MES integration so robot tasks come from real demand, safety engineering under ISO 10218/TS 15066 (cobots) with risk assessments, and exception workflows where robots hand off to humans with context. Autonomous mobile robots, palletizers, inspection robots and autonomous yard/warehouse vehicles all follow the same pattern.

The economics are engineered explicitly: cycle-time and labor-reallocation baselines, retrofit constraints, and a scaling path from cell to zone to site. We include the change package — operator training, maintenance contracts, floor-culture integration — because robots that the floor resents get unplugged.
